subject: Biotechnology
title: Beer, Bread, and Cheese
description: One-minute skill: Beer, Bread, and Cheese.

hook.text: The oldest biotech product is beer — Sumerians brewed it 6,000 years ago without knowing yeast existed.

buildup.text: Yeast converts sugar to alcohol and CO₂ — fermentation makes beer, wine, bread, and cheese possible.

discovery.text: Ancient people selected the best starters — unknowingly doing microbial breeding for thousands of years.

twist.text: Louis Pasteur proved fermentation was biological in 1857 — before that, it was considered purely chemical.

climax.text: Today's industrial fermentation produces antibiotics, vitamins, and biofuels — same principle, modern scale.

punchline.text: Biotech began with a loaf of bread — 6,000 years ago.

quiz.question: Who proved that fermentation is a biological process?
